public_rationale: The claim says agents will not work well until major progress in common sense, which may need wholesale changes in approach. It has no deadline. Neither 'work well' nor 'major progress in common sense' has an agreed measure. Scoring it would mean judging both whether agents now work well and whether a commonsense advance occurred, and the record settles neither. Agent benchmarks improved somewhat through 2025: TheAgentCompany's best rose from 24% to 30% of tasks. OpenAI still called its agent early-stage and error-prone. None of this tests whether the gain came with or without commonsense progress. So the claim cannot be scored as written.
limitations: Shown as not adjudicable rather than unresolved, because the claim's key terms have no plain operational reading.
